headline: IEA Projects 4,800 GW of New Renewable Energy Capacity by 2031
summary: The IEA reported that the Strait of Hormuz crisis and higher fuel prices are accelerating global renewable energy deployment, with emerging markets outside China projected to match advanced economies' clean energy additions through 2031.
why: The International Energy Agency provides authoritative analysis on global energy markets, influencing policy and investment trends across the traditional energy and renewables sectors.
